description: This file contains service functions for managing marketplace templates, including retrieving, deleting, and saving custom templates, as well as fetching predefined templates from various marketplace directories.

methods.name: getAllTemplates
methods.description: Fetches all marketplace templates from various directories, including chatflows, tools, and agentflowsv2, sorts them, and returns the list.

methods.name: deleteCustomTemplate
methods.description: Deletes a custom template by ID and workspace ID.

methods.name: _modifyTemplates
methods.description: Processes templates to parse JSON fields and set categories and other properties.

methods.name: getAllCustomTemplates
methods.description: Retrieves all custom templates for a workspace, including shared items, and processes them.

methods.name: saveCustomTemplate
methods.description: Saves a new or updated custom template, including handling chatflow or tool data.

methods.name: _generateExportFlowData
methods.description: Generates export JSON and determines framework type from flow data nodes and edges.
